WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT cnt
  FROM side_counts
  WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM side_counts)
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM side_counts)) AS average_excess
FROM above_avg
